releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.168: My Documents multi-word search, matching signed APK and Check for Update feed. Existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Documents: image files now have a Download button like My Memories; photos save through the existing Android Downloads/My Diary bridge. Open remains available; PDFs and other files are unchanged.
